blocks.text:
Upon landing at Mexico City International Airport, a friendly bilingual host will be waiting to welcome you, holding a sign with your name. From the moment you arrive, you’ll be greeted with warm hospitality and guided comfortably to your hotel located in the heart of Mexico City.

Once you’ve checked in, the remainder of the day is free for you to enjoy at your own pace. You may wish to relax after your journey, take a gentle walk through nearby plazas, or discover the city’s lively atmosphere for the first time. Perhaps enjoy a drink on a rooftop terrace at sunset or explore the neighborhood around your hotel—however you choose to begin, Mexico City offers a memorable start to your adventure.

Included:• Private arrival transfer• Overnight stay in Mexico City
